narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates is the federal vendor tracked for FY2026 to date. Brookhaven Science Associates has $830M in contract obligations so far this fiscal year, distributed across 2 awards with an average award size of $415M. Brookhaven Science Associates obligations are down 0.5% year over year. Brookhaven Science Associates received $830M from the Department of Energy and $16K from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration in FY2026 to date. Brookhaven Science Associates activity is concentrated in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) at $830M, with a secondary listing of Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $16K. Brookhaven Science Associates fiscal-year history shows obligations of $668M in FY21, $951M in FY22, $789M in FY23, $797M in FY24, $834M in FY25, and $830M in FY26. Brookhaven Science Associates current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, while the note clarifies that the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values rather than obligations.
